about: The files this site's executor must be found to run before a result from it is accepted, for dodona's own checks. This is NOT dodona's lock: the lock (protocol/lock.schema.json) pins whole tool trees by a digest verified against what upstream publishes, and nothing computes that yet. `sha256` is the digest the executor must measure for the file, and `basis` says where that digest came from; null would mean not pinned, and nothing recorded in that state ever counts. The Java runtime is whatever the executor's system provides; `system` is not a version, and pinning its launcher file says little about the runtime. A tool with a `floor` instead of a `sha256` is accepted at that version or any later one, a new major version included, as the queue's owner decided for its Java runtime (2026-11-20): the executor reads the version the runtime states (a release, on its own line, with exit status 0) and records its digest. A result's key holds the floor, not the build, so an upgrade of the tool, of any size, neither stops the checks nor makes their results stale. That is a trade-off made on purpose: a key is meant to change whenever the answer could, and a new build of the runtime could in principle change one; the build each result ran on is recorded beside it in the ledger (`tools_measured`), outside the key. Only the runtime's own version line is trusted, and it is read once per job, before the first case.

tools.name: java
tools.basis: The queue's owner keeps no exact Java build: the current one and newer must work (lobby message, 2026-11-20), and the owner asked that an upgrade not rerun everything. Java at the pinned path is accepted from 21.0.13 on, a newer major version included; each run records the build it measured, and each result the version it ran on. The launcher measured before, 8b0b1959..., was 21.0.13.0.3.

tools.name: tla2tools
tools.basis: Measured on the executor in CI run 44201829244 and equal, byte for byte, to tla2tools.jar of the upstream release v1.7.4 (github.com/tlaplus/tlaplus), downloaded and hashed on 2026-11-18.
